name: ReaLive MR
summary:
ReaLive MR is a professional Mixed Reality (MR) CPR training solution designed for Meta Quest devices.

The application overlays virtual CPR training content onto the user's real environment, allowing learners to see both their own hands and the virtual training scenario simultaneously. This provides a natural and immersive learning experience while maintaining awareness of the surrounding environment.

Key Features

• Mixed Reality-based CPR training
• AED education and emergency response training
• Seamle
